test_case.purpose: Measure the designated two-endpoint IB path at q2 against an approved98% denominator using a bounded, tracked lifecycle.

test_case.test_command: Do not execute until lifecycle is resolved. Then capture topology/counters, start one approved OpenSM owner, start tracked server/client with the exact selected lifecycle and profile, retain complete output/telemetry, terminate exact PIDs under the approved rule, restore network/OpenSM state and compare to the bound98% denominator.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized lifecycle completes/terminates cleanly, measured bandwidth meets98% of the approved denominator and no IB/link/host errors remain.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires one authoritative lifecycle, exact two-endpoint path, complete log, defined denominator and clean termination/health. Ambiguous infinite processes or arbitrary spec values cannot pass.
safety_gate: No run until `-D 3` versus infinite is resolved.
Confirm OpenSM ownership and isolated path.
Track server/client PIDs and bounded stop timeout.
Abort on link/counter/host fault; no broad kill or auto retry.
expected_evidence: Resolved lifecycle approval and exact commands/PIDs
98% calculation, cleanup and final fabric health
test_case.recovery: If a process remains infinite beyond the authorized stop point, terminate only recorded PIDs, preserve both endpoint logs and IB counters, restore prior OpenSM/IP state and verify subnet, ports and hosts before any new lifecycle decision.
